scripts.hasura:regenerate: rm -rf hasura_metadata.json && npx squid-hasura-configuration regenerate && node scripts/patch-hasura-row-limit.js
scripts.meta:update: npx squid-substrate-metadata-explorer --rpc "${RPC:?Set RPC env var}" --out metadata.jsonl
scripts.gen:migration: rm -rf db/migrations && npm run build && npx squid-typeorm-migration generate -n InitialSchema && node scripts/patch-migration-gin-indexes.js
scripts.db:recreate: npx sqd down && npx sqd up
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:recreate && npm run meta:update && npm run gen:types && npm run gen:model && npm run build && rm -rf db/migrations && npx squid-typeorm-migration generate -n InitialSchema && node scripts/patch-migration-gin-indexes.js && npm run db:migrate
scripts.generate: npm run meta:delete && docker compose -f docker-compose-generate.yml up -d && npm run meta:update && npm run gen:types && npm run gen:model && npm run build && npm run gen:migration && docker compose -f docker-compose-generate.yml down && npm run hasura:regenerate
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate && npm run hasura:apply && PROMETHEUS_PORT=9090 node --require=dotenv/config lib/main.js
